title: Spontal-N: A Corpus of Interactional Spoken Norwegian
manual_evidence: Entire four 30-minute conversations have manual orthographic transcription. Approximately 50% received automatic phoneme alignment; approximately 7% of that automatic phoneme transcription was manually corrected and used as a gold standard.
available_primary_data: studio-quality audio/video; manual orthographic transcripts; partially phone-aligned annotations with a manually corrected subset (public distribution and exact corrected-subset isolation still to verify)
notes: Do not admit automatic phone alignments wholesale. Core eligibility depends on isolating the manually corrected ~7% phone subset or using independently manual transcript-derived production units. Preserve as review until authoritative downloadable objects and correction provenance can be enumerated. Primary recordings are non-singing and suitable in principle.
